title: Session idle timeout
description: Ends a signed-in session after this long with no request. This is not the token lifetime, which ends a session a fixed time after sign-in whether or not it was in use; both apply.
label: Minutes
hint: 0 turns it off. The largest value is {{max}} minutes.

messages.saved: Sessions now end after {{minutes}} minutes with no request.
messages.disabled: The idle timeout is off. Only the token lifetime ends a session.

errors.load: The setting could not be read
errors.save: The setting could not be saved
errors.outOfRange: Enter a value between 0 and {{max}} minutes.
